title: Get Away from the Crowds - Wine & Charcuterie Tour
includes: Personal door-to-door pick-up and drop-off for a seamless Niagara wine tasting
Taste a minimum of 12 flavors of wine per guest (including Ice wine)
Entry/Admission 3 Niagara’s award winning wineries & sample a variety of red, white, and sweet wines
All taxes, admission fees, tasting fees, tour fees, hotel pick-up and drop-off are included
1 mini-charcuterie (meats & cheeses) paired with wine included at one of our stops
Intimate, small-group tour experience groups are limited to 6 guests to ensure quality interaction
Discover the beautifully scenic countryside of this award-winning wine region
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the beautiful scenery and the amazing wines of Niagara-on-the-Lake 3 Wineries to visit -- Minimum of 12 different wine tastings per guest (including Ice wine) this tour includes all your transport so you can sample all the different wines without worrying about driving. Taste the best of Niagara wine region, part of the larger Wine Country in Ontario. Enjoy all of the indulgent tastings and high-quality experiences, so your time is spent touring wineries and enjoying tastings not driving back and forth between destinations. Experience a selection from 100 wineries in the region, with inspirations from Italy, France, Spain, Germany, and California. It will take about 4 hours and will make for an eventful and unforgettable day.

• Make sure to take wine home as most of the wines you taste are only available at the winery!
